subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay bounded media from unmentioned group messages for later mentioned turns, and what limits should apply to media kind, TTL, local-path exposure, and group visibility?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but fixing it changes how bystander group attachments can enter later model context, so automation should not choose that privacy/security boundary.

options.title: Approve bounded local image retention
options.body: Record only bounded local image media for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it through the existing recent-history image pipeline under current group authorization rules.

options.title: Keep text-only group history
options.body: Preserve the safer current behavior and document that unmentioned Telegram media is not replayed unless it is part of the current or visible reply turn.

options.title: Require live design proof first
options.body: Keep this issue open until a proposed PR demonstrates the exact Telegram failure and the bounded retention behavior with redacted live proof.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded local image retention
recommendation.body: Record only bounded local image media for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it through the existing recent-history image pipeline under current group authorization rules.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns the shared history-media contract and has the strongest history signal for the security-sensitive boundary this fix would reuse.
